messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from Annexure to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 41):
"""
5 Brand Name of the Product 6 Date of first approval of the PMC (as applicable) 7 Date of launch of the Product 8 Date(s) of approval of subsequent Revision/ modification of the product by PMC (as applicable) in chronological order. S. No Date of approval of subsequent Revision /Modification(s) 9 Date of withdrawal of the product 10 Date of approval of PMC for withdrawal of Product
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"What is the date of first approval of the PMC for a product?","answer":"The date of first approval of the PMC for a product is recorded in the field titled \"Date of first approval of the PMC (as applicable).\"","facts":["Date of first approval of the PMC (as applicable)"]},{"question":"When was the product withdrawn?","answer":"The withdrawal date of the product is listed under the field \"Date of withdrawal of the product.\"","facts":["Date of withdrawal of the product"]}]}
